chunks: Sa'd narrated from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Abi 'Abd Allah, from his father, from 'Ali عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in washing blood with saliva.

key_terms.الدَّمُ: blood, treated here as a substance to be removed
key_terms.بِالْبُصَاقِ: with saliva; the means used for washing
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no objection or harm; an expression of permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wash blood with saliva according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling concerning taharah and the removal of blood. It indicates the permissibility of using saliva to wash away blood, reflecting a practical ruling within the laws of ritual purity.
